title: Share a Cart with Pinia
short_description: Build a Pinia store and share its reactive data between a catalog and the cart summary.
description: In this challenge, you will complete the store connecting a course catalog to a cart summary.
The catalog will add products through actions, and CartSummary will consume reactive getters from the same store with storeToRefs.
instructions: In stores/cart.ts, implement itemCount and total as getters derived from items.
Complete addItem so it adds the received product to the cart.
Complete clearCart so it empties the items array.
In CartSummary.vue, use storeToRefs to get itemCount and total without losing reactivity.
Get clearCart from the store so the button can empty the cart.

hints.title: Derive the getters
hints.body: `itemCount` can use `state.items.length`, and `total` can reduce `state.items` by adding each `price`.

hints.title: Change the store from actions
hints.body: Inside an Option Store action, you can access `items` through `this.items`.

hints.title: Preserve reactivity
hints.body: Import `storeToRefs` from `pinia` and pass `cart` to it. Actions such as `clearCart` can be destructured directly.
